nodes.title: SG-8.4.3 quality gate: REQ-531 context.md real module table and stack
nodes.body:
Context: the last check found the repo-root context.md still holds README-only Purpose/Stack/Entry points/Workflows text, 'hello Worldseed', 'echo no build' and UNKNOWN placeholders, so the contextDoc, contextPaths and contextStack tests fail. game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts and docsCheck.ts already hold the checkers. game/src, game/frontend/src, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ all exist on disk. Desired: contextModuleProblems and contextStackProblems return [] for the real file with exports unchanged. Why: docs must match the code (game-docs skill).

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the real context.md, when contextModuleProblems runs with existsSync from the repo root, then it returns []
- Given the real context.md, when contextStackProblems runs, then it returns []
- Given contextDoc.ts and docsCheck.ts, when their exports are listed, then they are unchanged and only comments differ
- Given npm run typecheck in game/frontend, then it is clean


## Scope
- In scope: context.md module table and Stack content (written by Devion from these tickets)
- In scope: comment-only edits in contextDoc.ts and docsCheck.ts
- Out of scope: backend/ Go code and API
- Out of scope: gameplay changes
- Out of scope: new features
- Preserve: every exported symbol of contextDoc.ts and docsCheck.ts
- Preserve: Phaser pinned ~3.90.0
- Preserve: no source file over 200 lines
- Preserve: no test deleted or skipped


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- No source file in game/src or game/frontend/src over 200 lines
- backend/ and the contribution/round API out of scope


## Definition of done
- contextDoc, contextPaths, contextStack, docsCheck tests pass
- typecheck clean


## Clarifying questions
- None
